
Crop Production 

ISSN: 1936-3737

Released November 10, 2026, by the National Agricultural Statistics Service 
(NASS), Agricultural Statistics Board, United States Department of 
Agriculture (USDA).

This report was approved on November 10, 2026.

Corn production for grain is forecast at 15.9 bill
Soybean production for beans is forecast at a record high 4.57 billion bushels, up less than 1 percent from the 
previous forecast and up 7 percent from 2025. Yields are expected to average a record high 53.3 bushels per acre, 
up 0.2 bushel from the previous forecast and up 0.3 bushel from 2025.

All cotton production is forecast at 13.2 million 480-pound bales, down 2 percent from the previous forecast and 
down 5 percent from 2025. The average yield is forecast at 775 pounds per harvested acre, down 15 pounds from the 
previous forecast and down 77 pounds from 2025.

The current corn and soybean production forecasts are based on information collected before harvest was complete,
